get.description: Response includes mapDiseaseSelection and standardDiseaseSelection. Missing legacy fields default to no selection and no tags. Profile updates preserve tags/map selection; any changed condition text/status requires reconfirmation. Explicit NONE and profile deletion clear both; text-only UNSET preserves tags. New atomic tag/free-text writes use /api/v1/me/conditions; map use has its separate confirmation endpoint. See disease-personalization-v1.json.
